name: axe-core-a11y-sweep
approach: axe-core/playwright sweep over 20 template-distinct URLs × mobile + desktop projects = 40 runs. Failing on serious/critical impact only; moderate warn-logged. Per-URL JSON reports in axe-reports/ for aggregation.

rules_violated.help: Elements must meet minimum color contrast ratio thresholds
Select element must have an accessible name
Elements must only use supported ARIA attributes

fixed_in_phase.fix: /en/ask page + Ask NakshIQ widget: added aria-label='Send question' + aria-hidden on SVG icon
/en/gap-year duration range slider: added aria-label + aria-valuemin/max/now
/en/road-conditions destination thumbnail: alt no longer falls back to empty string
Added aria-label to 8 <select> elements across review-form, question-form, gap-year, permits, cost-index, plan

carried_forward.scope: Systemic — text-muted-foreground/40 (14 instances) + /50 (31) + /60 (39) + /70 (93) across the app
carried_forward.why_defer: Mass-editing 177 instances is risky without design review. The /40 and /50 tiers are guaranteed to fail AA but each instance had a visual-hierarchy reason for its choice.
carried_forward.recommended_next_step: Token-level fix: bump --muted-foreground darkness one notch in tailwind config so /60 → ~4.6:1 ratio (passes AA). Then mass-replace /40 → /60, /50 → /70 with sed.

carried_forward.scope: Destination page traveler-type pseudo-tabs use role='tab' + aria-selected='true' but no enclosing role='tablist' container
carried_forward.why_defer: Belongs in a tablist semantics conversion — change `<button role='tab'>` to wrap in proper tablist + tabpanel structure
